verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents built-in brute force protection that temporarily or permanently locks accounts after too many login failures, which covers the brute-force part of the story. The pack has no evidence of bot protection (such as CAPTCHA or bot detection) or credential-stuffing defenses (such as breached-password checks or IP/velocity throttling), so only part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: bot/CAPTCHA protection, credential-stuffing detection, in-depth lockout configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
